gemini.title: Country Of Birth And Nationality Data 2021 Lgd
gemini.abstract: Country Of Birth And Nationality Data 2021 Lgd is an authoritative dataset published by Northern Ireland Statistics and Research Agency. It contains records relating to country of birth and nationality data 2021 lgd.
gemini.lineage: Published by the Northern Ireland Statistics and Research Agency as open statistics and boundary data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.
gemini.responsible_organisation: Northern Ireland Statistics and Research Agency
